SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as num_boats,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY yt_per_angler DESC
LIMIT 40

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cls IN ('three_quarter', 'overnight', 'day_1_5') THEN yt ELSE 0 END) as yt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cls IN ('three_quarter', 'overnight', 'day_1_5') THEN anglers ELSE 0 END) as anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cls IN ('three_quarter', 'overnight', 'day_1_5') THEN yt ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cls IN ('three_quarter', 'overnight', 'day_1_5') THEN anglers ELSE 0 END), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy >= 140 AND fish_date_doy <= 245
GROUP BY fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy
